result.title: FlashVSR+: Efficient Video Super-Resolution via Hybrid Attention and Reward-Yield Distribution Matching
result.summary: Recent video super-resolution (VSR) models achieve efficient one-step generation through diffusion distillation. However, high-resolution inference remains costly, and distilled models are difficult to align with human preferences. These challenges call for improvements in both model architecture and training strategy. We present \textbf{FlashVSR+} to address both limitations. On the architecture side, we introduce hybrid attention based on the strong locality observed in pretrained VSR models, while retaining sparse global interaction for long-range consistency. It achieves up to $2\times$ DiT speedup and 45\% lower peak memory, enabling spatially untiled 4K VSR on a single 24GB RTX 4090. On the training side, we propose Reward-Yield Distribution Matching Distillation (Ry-DMD) for preference-aligned one-step generation. Ry-DMD uses reward-weighted teacher rollouts to incorporate black-box rewards into distribution matching, without backpropagating through the reward model. We further show that Ry-DMD generalizes beyond VSR to T2I generation. Together, FlashVSR+ delivers stronger restoration quality and substantially improves high-resolution efficiency, with consistent gains in user preference. We release our code, models, and training data at \href{https://www.flashvsr.tech}{\textcolor{FlashBlue}{\textbf{www.flashvsr.tech}}}.

AI.brief_summary: FlashVSR+ 面向视频超分，提出以局部性为主的混合注意力加稀疏全局交互来降低 DiT 推理开销，并用奖励加权的教师 rollout 做分布匹配蒸馏，实现一步生成与偏好对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属低层视觉任务，但其「多步教师轨迹蒸馏为一步生成器」与奖励加权分布匹配的监督方式，可能为 latent 推理状态的轨迹训练、贡献分配和一步状态更新提供借鉴线索，值得核查；混合注意力对局部与全局信息的取舍也与内部状态保留视觉细节的问题相关，但均属推测。
